description.value: You've pulled Hive-touched hosts and Choir zealots alike back from the brink without flinching. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Repeat a Ritual or counteract possession-based effects, and a critical failure never harms you directly.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Repeat a Ritual' and 'counteract possession-based effects' have no confirmed action tags to predicate on (rituals are a separate document type from standard skill actions), and the critical-failure protection ('never harms you directly') has no hook either.
